title: Methylglyoxal adduct force field and SOD1 glycation simulations
description: AMBER-compatible residue libraries for four methylglyoxal-derived advanced glycation end-products (MG-H1, argpyrimidine, CEA, CEL), a structure-validation gate that detects stereochemical inversion introduced by adduct grafting, and the simulation and analysis code for a study of site-specific glycation in apo, disulfide-reduced superoxide dismutase 1.
